note: ORPHAN Pro 16:15 — in the light of a king's face there is life; his favour is like the spring rain.

dims.v: benevolent goodwill — a king's favour, life-giving as spring rain
the favour of a king, whose lighted face means life and whose goodwill is like the clouds that bring the spring rain — the benevolent regard of power that revives and refreshes those it rests upon
the ruler's goodwill that falls life-giving as rain on those beneath it

ratson (favour/goodwill) — 'his FAVOR is like the clouds that bring the spring rain' (16:15); a king's benevolent goodwill is life-giving, refreshing as timely rain. The favour of the powerful, rightly given, revives (cf 19:12; 16:14).
